title: Quality Gate Result
description: Structured record of a quality gate check at the end of a workflow phase. Documents which criteria passed, which failed, and what the next action is. PASS advances to the next phase; FAIL returns to the triggering stage; OVERRIDE advances with documented justification.

gate_id.description: Unique identifier for this gate check

phase.description: The workflow phase this gate was applied at the end of

run_id.description: Cache run ID this gate check belongs to

artifact_ref.description: Path or ID of the primary artifact being evaluated (e.g. brief.json, outline.json, draft file path)

decision.description: PASS=all required criteria met, advance to next phase; FAIL=one or more required criteria not met, return to current phase; OVERRIDE=advancing despite unmet criteria (requires justification)

override_reason.description: Required if decision is OVERRIDE — must explain why advancing is acceptable despite unmet criteria and who authorized the override

criteria_results.description: Per-criterion evaluation results — every criterion defined for this phase must appear

criterion.description: The specific gate criterion being evaluated (from doctrine/QUALITY_GATES.md for this phase)

result.description: pass=criterion is met; fail=criterion is not met; not-applicable=criterion does not apply to this document type

notes.description: Additional context for the result — required for fail, optional for pass

unmet_criteria.description: List of criterion descriptions where result=fail — must be empty for PASS decision (or all failures overridden)

next_action.description: What happens next: if PASS, the next phase and command to invoke; if FAIL, the stage to return to and what must be corrected; if OVERRIDE, same as PASS with override note

created_by.description: Agent ID that evaluated this gate (typically lead-editor or the phase owner)
